This is the first cardiology lesson to carry a tutor, and its register is deliberately unlike the emergency lessons that came before it: nobody is deteriorating, and the failure modes are a word, a number and a reflex. The word is "atypical", which the pattern beat refuses by name — it has meant everything from "not classic angina" to "probably nothing", it performs worse in women, and contemporary guidance has dropped it, so the beat records what happens, when, for how long and what relieves it instead.
